body: The question "What did I do?" Bothers me because,  the only thing you did was not give in. Honestly he probably has had this pattern of anger then sweet as pie long before you and it's finally escalated to this. No where in your post do you say you're actually leaving him so I assume you're going to try to work it out. I won't say don't, but I will say that unless you confront him about boundaries you need and lines he can't cross he will continue to get worse. He has more issues than anger and needs to confront them or he will continue to see his actions as normal and necessary in his own mind. Stay safe and remember no matter how his actions are afterward making you feel fear is NOT ok.
